headline: Schaeffler to Cut 3,460 Jobs and Close Five Sites Amid Auto Crisis
summary: German auto parts supplier Schaeffler announced plans to cut nearly 3,500 jobs and close five sites as the crisis in the European automotive sector deepens.
why: Schaeffler is a major supplier to European car brands; significant restructuring reflects broader cost pressures and demand challenges across the European automotive manufacturing industry.

impacts.name: Schaeffler AG
impacts.why: Massive job cuts and facility closures indicate severe operational restructuring and cost pressures.
